name: blob-animation
title: Blob Animation
description: Blob Animation is a React component for a morphing blob in pure CSS, the kind of blob animation used in hero sections, behind avatars and as page decoration. The shape is a box whose eight-value border radius moves between four keyframes, so the browser interpolates an organic outline with no SVG path morphing and no JavaScript per frame. Opposite edges of every radius add up to the full side, which keeps the outline closed and smooth instead of pinching into corners. The four shapes come from a seed, so a seed always gives the same blob on the server and the client, and wobble sets how far the outline strays from a circle. Four looks: solid is a gradient blob with a soft highlight and an inner shade, soft blurs the gradient into a glow, outline draws a gradient ring that morphs with the shape, and image masks a photo with the blob while keeping it upright as the outline turns. A slow rotation hides the four-keyframe rhythm. Reduced motion holds the first shape still. The stylesheet is injected once, with no global CSS or dependencies.
